description: This file defines the class SugarFieldCronSchedule, which extends SugarFieldBase, and provides methods for generating day and weekday options, as well as setting up display parameters for a cron schedule field in SugarCRM. It includes methods for formatting dates and assigning options for display in the user interface.

classes.name: SugarFieldCronSchedule
classes.description: A class for managing and displaying cron schedule options within the SugarCRM platform.

methods.name: getDays
methods.description: Generates an array of day numbers with ordinal suffixes for a range of dates starting from May 1, 1986.

methods.name: getWeekDays
methods.description: Generates an array of weekday abbreviations for a week starting from May 4, 1986.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the display parameters for the cron schedule field, including days, weekdays, hours, and minutes options.

methods.name: padNumbers
methods.description: Pads a number with a leading zero if necessary for consistent formatting.
